body:
Myk's ask (2026-08-29, in chat, design settled in the same conversation): the admin page's
container view should quantify each container like a filesystem - how many deltas live there
physically vs how many are linked in by membership, and how many of the data deltas are DARK:
belonging to no hyperview, gatherable by no registered lens. Dark is the read-side soup
detector, the complement of SPEC 49.5's write-side metronome.

Build against the working spec at .adlc/specs/55-container-census.md. The mechanism is settled:
physical/linked falls out of the posture model (separate and inbox pools hold residents; shared
memberships select primary deltas); dark uses the surviving-lens context union the listing door
already maintains (listingContexts over groupPrograms - H6-safe against superseded bindings),
over DATA-class members only (the SPEC 49 classifier), stated as an approximation in the safe
direction (context intersection can say possibly-lit for a delta a Term would filter, so true
darkness is undercounted - an advisory metric must not over-alarm). The census renders on the
container DETAIL page, which already pays the scope read; the dashboard tree stays unannotated
until the swept index exists (H8, stated).

Myk's blessing covers plan, implementation, merges, and a release cut, unless a significant
obstacle appears.

Acceptance criteria:
- (a) The census reading: a separate container counts its pool residents as physical; a shared
  container counts its selected members as linked; totals match the scope read. Verify:
  test/gateway/container-census.test.ts.
- (b) Dark counting is two-sided and honest: a data-class member whose contexts no surviving
  lens reads is counted dark; a member a registered lens gathers is not; law, trust, and
  erasure vocabulary is its own bucket, never dark; a superseded binding's contexts do not
  light anything. Verify: test/gateway/container-census.test.ts.
- (c) The container detail page renders the census with data-census markers - physical, linked,
  dark - and the dashboard tree is byte-unchanged. Verify: test/server/admin-census.test.ts.
title: The container census: physical, linked, and dark
